gates.reason: a searching player must beat a random one, or there is nothing to play
a game that mostly fails to finish is not a game, and a half of the ladder that mostly fails to finish is not rescued by the other half finishing
with no choices there is no play
a game that competent players almost always draw is not a contest, and averaging in the games their weaker opponents lost outright does not make it one
a game decided before either player has developed anything is not a game; pooled with a shuffle at the other end of the ladder the mean describes no game that was played
doubling the thinking budget must be worth at least a few Elo, or skill does not exist here

a game where half of all contests are over in a handful of moves is decided by an opening trap, not by play; read on the half of the ladder that falls into the trap, because every quick kill in a run is a weak-half game and the strong half is only the denominator
